name: nGZGraphic4::TextureFilterSupported(texture) (cdecl: level 0's format filterable on the texture's device; false only for D3DERR_NOTAVAILABLE)
notes: Lane RJ (O-c2). Cdecl, one argument (callers clean up). Callers: the state cache's sampler validators 0x189a70 / 0x189e40 (ours, cDeviceStateDXValidate.cpp) and the image's 0x18cc40; hooked at the RVA. GetDevice, GetLevelDesc(0), the device's GetCreationParameters, GetDisplayMode(0) and GetDirect3D, the resource type, then IDirect3D9::CheckDeviceFormat(adapter, device type, display format, level usage | D3DUSAGE_QUERY_FILTER, type, level format); each failing call reported (LogD3DError, the file 0xda0e78 and lines 0xf3-0xff, 0x10b) and the check goes on; the check's result reported when it fails with anything but D3DERR_NOTAVAILABLE; false only for D3DERR_NOTAVAILABLE; the device and IDirect3D9 released. Difftest TextureSupport_Texture (tests/gz_texture_support.cpp, 1500 seeded cases: drawfx fakes of the texture, device and IDirect3D9 that write their out-parameters whatever they answer, each of the five calls answering success, S_FALSE or one of three failures, CheckDeviceFormat 0, S_FALSE, NOTAVAILABLE, a positive code or a failure; seeded level description, creation parameters and display mode; compared: the log with LogD3DError's reports as notes, the result and the three reference counts). Mutants (11): the query flag dropped, the usage dropped, the adapter format from the level, a fixed resource type, any failure unsupported, NOTAVAILABLE reported, S_FALSE reported, the device not released, two report lines, display mode of swap chain 1: 11 killed.
